primary_metric: mean accuracy across 9 fixed corruption conditions
prior_art_status: core mechanisms have clear prior art (Cutout/occlusion augmentation and validation-weighted model ensembles); exact combination not exhaustively searched; novelty not established
limitations: PCA warnings during evaluation: divide-by-zero, overflow, and invalid-value matmul warnings; metrics completed but require numerical follow-up.
Block augmentation is coupled to PCA while pixel augmentation uses StandardScaler, so augmentation geometry is not isolated.
Raw margins are scale-sensitive and produced essentially uniform weights; margin weighting had negligible effect versus uniform averaging.
Only three seeds, one small digits dataset, and synthetic corruption distributions.
Baseline SVC hyperparameters were fixed defaults rather than selected by the proposal’s stated training-fold cross-validation.
preregistration_pass_rule: candidate gain >= .01 over control and not worse than uniform ensemble
